admin.moduleOff: This organization has not switched on supplier risk yet. Ask the BCS team to switch it on

tiers.title: Supplier risk tiers
tiers.intro: The lowest points of each tier, how often it is assessed again, and which tiers must be assessed before a PO. New values take effect only once another administrator confirms them
tiers.notSeeded: This organization has no three tiers yet. The BCS team loads them from the organization's data form
tiers.engineReadsEffective: Tiers and the check before a PO use the values in effect only. A value waiting for confirmation affects no supplier yet
tiers.waiting: Waiting for someone else to confirm
tiers.proposedByYou: You proposed this. Another administrator must confirm it
tiers.confirmBody: Once confirmed, the values take effect at once for the next assessment and the next check before a PO. Completed assessments keep their result
tiers.confirmed: Confirmed. The new values are in effect
tiers.dialogDescription: Change only what should change; only values that differ from those in effect are sent. Lowest points must rise from low to high
tiers.lowFromZero: The low tier always starts at 0 points
tiers.numbersRequired: Fill in the points, review months and reminder days of every tier as whole numbers
tiers.minPointsHint: A total of this many points or more counts as this tier

policy.title: Risk check policy

screening.processesPersonalData: Work with personal data starts at
screening.accessesSystems: Work with information systems starts at
screening.accessesPremises: Work on the organization's premises starts at

policy.highRiskCategories: Categories that are always high risk
policy.categoriesHint: Category codes separated by commas, such as PROF
policy.registryFlagBlocks: A supplier with a registry flag gets no PO
policy.mediumOverdueBlocks: A medium tier past its review gets no PO
policy.overrideChatButton: Overrides may be approved from the chat button
policy.waiting: Waiting for someone else to confirm
policy.proposedByYou: You proposed this. Another administrator must confirm it
policy.confirmBody: Once confirmed, the policy applies to new assessments and the next check before a PO
policy.confirmed: Confirmed. The new policy is in effect
policy.notSeeded: This organization has no risk check policy yet. The BCS team loads it from the organization's data form
policy.dialogDescription: The policy sets the starting tier of work and what holds back a PO. It takes effect once another administrator confirms it

questionnaire.title: Supplier risk questionnaire
questionnaire.intro: The versions of the questionnaire suppliers answer. Draft a new version from the one in effect, edit its questions, and send it for another administrator to publish. Open assessments keep their version to the end
questionnaire.codeHint: Capital letters, such as RQ-ORG. Every version keeps the code
questionnaire.emptyHint: Create the first draft, then add questions
questionnaire.readOnly: This version can no longer change. Draft a new version to change questions
questionnaire.noQuestions: This version has no questions yet
questionnaire.noQuestionsHint: Add the first question. A question needs at least two options
questionnaire.aiReadableShort: The AI assistant may read its evidence
questionnaire.removeBody: Only this draft changes. Published versions and assessments using them stay as they are

form.description: Fill in step by step: words, options, then conditions. Everything is checked again before saving
form.codeHint: Form RQ-area-two digits, such as RQ-GEN-01. The sheet and linked certificates use this code
form.optionsHint: Points are whole numbers from 0. An option with a lowest tier puts the supplier at that tier or above
form.optionEvidence: Choose this when answered by a certificate
form.whenHint: No condition means every assessment asks it
form.whenComplex: This question's condition is more complex than this page can edit ({when}). It is kept as it is
form.evidenceScopeHint: Such as ISO 27001. A certificate of that scope that covers the work may answer this question
form.aiReadable: Let the AI assistant read this question's evidence files
form.aiReadableHint: Only for questions whose evidence is a policy document without personal data. The supplier still ticks consent for each file

lint.title: Checks before sending
lint.clean: This version passes the checks and may be sent for publishing
lint.warnings: {count} things to look at (it may still be sent)

issue.RISK_LINT_CONDITION: Question {question}: its condition reads something an assessment does not have ({reason})
issue.RISK_LINT_SCOPE_REQUIRED: Question {question}: document type {type} may have several copies, so the question must name the standard or scope it asks for
issue.RISK_LINT_UNKNOWN_QUESTION: Document type {type} is linked to question {question}, which this version does not have

reason.CODE_FORMAT: the code is not of the form RQ-area-two digits
reason.DUPLICATE_QUESTION: the code is used by another question
reason.POINTS: points must be whole numbers from 0
reason.MIN_TIER: the lowest tier is not valid
reason.MORE_THAN_ONE_EVIDENCE_OPTION: only one option may be chosen by evidence
reason.CATEGORY_TAKES_ANY_IN: an item category is compared with has a category in only

preview.title: Try the question set
preview.intro: Pick the screening answers of a piece of work to see its starting tier and the questions this version asks. Uses the policy in effect
preview.noneAsked: This version asks nothing for this work

decide.submit: Send for another administrator to publish
decide.submitted: Sent. Waiting for another administrator to publish
decide.fixLintFirst: Fix what the checks say must be fixed before sending
decide.sentByYou: You sent this version. Another administrator must publish or send it back
decide.publishBody: This version takes effect from {effective}. Assessments opened after that use it; open ones keep their version to the end

code.FAILED: That did not work. Try again
code.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back. Press again; the same request runs once only
code.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again and retry
code.MODULE_DISABLED: This organization has not switched on supplier risk
code.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this before you. Reload the page and check again
code.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The status has changed. Reload the page and check again
code.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something is missing or not valid
code.RISK_TIER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The risk tiers are not set yet. Please contact your administrator
code.RISK_POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED: The supplier risk policy is not confirmed yet. Please contact your administrator
code.FILE_NOT_SCANNED: The file is still being checked for viruses. Try again in a moment.
code.FILE_INFECTED: This file failed the security check, so it cannot be opened.
code.RISK_OVERRIDE_OPEN: This supplier already has an open risk override
code.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: The DOA in effect has no risk override rule. Please contact the DOA administrator
code.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver was found under the DOA. Please contact the administrator
code.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: The DOA has no approver above you. Please let someone else ask for it

reason.SAME_EDITOR: Whoever proposed or sent it cannot confirm or publish it. Another administrator must
reason.TIER_ORDER: Lowest points must rise from low to high, and low starts at 0
reason.PENDING_CHANGE_EXISTS: A proposal is already waiting. Confirm or discard it before proposing again
reason.NO_CHANGE: The proposal is the same as the values in effect
reason.NO_PENDING_CHANGE: Nothing is waiting for confirmation any more
reason.PENDING_CHANGED: The proposal has changed. Reload the page and check again
reason.DRAFT_EXISTS: A draft or a version waiting to publish exists already
reason.RISK_LINT: This version does not pass the checks yet. See the checks before sending
reason.EFFECTIVE_IN_PAST: The effective date cannot be before today
reason.LATER_VERSION_SCHEDULED: Another version takes effect on the same day or later
reason.CHECKSUM: The questions changed after it was sent. Send it again
reason.CONDITION: The condition reads something an assessment does not have
reason.OPTION_EVIDENCE: Only one option may be chosen by evidence
reason.SCOPE_REQUIRED: Name the standard or scope asked for
reason.NOT_A_PERMUTATION: The new order must name every question
reason.UNKNOWN_CATEGORY: A category code the organization uses in neither its catalogue nor its POs
reason.POLICY_UNREADABLE: The policy in effect cannot be read. Please contact the BCS team
reason.DOA_ADMIN_SEPARATED: The organization separated its DOA administrators. Only a DOA administrator may do this
reason.REGISTRY_BLOCKED: The supplier has a registry flag, so no override can be asked for
reason.OVERRIDE_EXPIRY_PAST: The last day may not be before the day it is sent
reason.OVERRIDE_EXPIRY_TOO_FAR: The last day is further than the organization allows from the day it is sent
reason.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The cap must be above zero
reason.PO_OTHER_SUPPLIER: The purchase order is of another supplier
reason.PO_NOT_OPEN: The purchase order is closed or cancelled
reason.NOT_REQUESTER: Only who asked for it changes, sends or cancels it
reason.NO_DEPARTMENT: The requester has no main department, so no approver can be found. Please contact the administrator

assessment.title: Supplier risk assessment
assessment.heading: Assessment {number} · {supplier}
assessment.cancelBody: A cancelled assessment cannot be reopened; open a new one. Open reviewer tasks are cancelled too.
assessment.fillBody: Choose the answers the supplier gave. Answers filled in are recorded as procurement's, and whoever fills in cannot review this assessment.
assessment.lockedByEvidence: Answered by a certificate; not changed here

ai.title: Filled in by AI — please check
ai.intro: AI proposed some answers from the supplier's documents. Tick each one to confirm it, or choose another answer yourself.

checks.EVIDENCE_MISSING: No certificate in the system confirms this answer yet. Check it before you confirm.

ai.confirm: Checked: use the answer AI proposed for this question
ai.confirmed: The answer AI proposed is confirmed
ai.pending: Waiting: the answer AI proposed for this question is not confirmed, so the assessment cannot be sent
ai.leaveBlank: Leave this question unanswered (do not use the AI's answer)

list.title: Risk overrides
list.intro: Requests to let purchase orders go to a supplier the risk gate holds, within a cap and until a last day, approved under the DOA
list.forSupplier: For every purchase order of the supplier within the cap
list.empty: No override in this state yet
list.emptyHint: An override is asked for from the supplier risk band of a purchase order the gate holds
list.emptyHintRequest: Ask for an override from the supplier risk band of a purchase order the gate holds, with “Ask for an override”

form.title: Ask for a risk override
form.intro: Give the reason, the cap with VAT of the purchase orders it lets out (counted across all of them) and the last day it may be used. Saved, check it once more before sending it for approval
form.label: Risk override request
form.fromPo: Open this form from “Ask for an override” on the supplier risk band of a purchase order the gate holds
form.noRule: The DOA in effect has no risk override rule (RISK_OVERRIDE), so none can be asked for. Please contact the DOA administrator
form.flagged: This supplier has a registry flag, so no override can be asked for: it needs a new risk assessment
form.inactive: This supplier is not active, so no override can be asked for
form.notFound: This purchase order or supplier was not found
form.openExists: This supplier already has an open override ({number}): edit or send that one instead
form.reasonHint: At least {min} characters. The approver reads it before deciding
form.reasonShort: The reason needs at least {min} characters
form.capHint: The gross with VAT of every purchase order let out under it, added up; the DOA finds the approver by it
form.capInvalid: Enter an amount above zero with at most 2 decimals
form.expiresOnHint: From today to {last}. Sent on another day, it is checked against the day it is sent
form.dateRequired: Choose the last day it may be used

facts.heading: Risk override

tierSource.SCREENING: from the screening of the work

facts.poAll: Every purchase order of the supplier within the cap

detail.title: Risk override
detail.heading: Override {number}

hint.DRAFT: This draft has not reached an approver yet. Check it, then press “Send for approval”
hint.RETURNED: The approver returned it for changes. Change it and send it again; the DOA finds the approvers anew
hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Waiting for the DOA approver. The approver opens the reason first: there is no approve button in the chat
hint.APPROVED: Purchase orders of this supplier pass the gate within the cumulative cap until the last day; the assessment still has to be done

detail.posUsing: Purchase orders let out under it

decision.RETURNED: The approver returned it for changes

detail.cancelBody: Once cancelled it cannot be changed or sent: a new one must be asked for
